authorInfo.bio: Anthony Trollope (1815–1882) is the author of The Warden. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.

description: "Castle Richmond" by Anthony Trollope is a novel written between 1859 and 1860. Set in southwestern Ireland during the Great Famine, it follows two Protestant cousins who compete for the hand of an impoverished noblewoman.
